program='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    coords8 = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 8]
    markers = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (0, 8)]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in coords8)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in coords8)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in coords8)
    c1 = max(c for r, c in coords8)
    kr0 = min(r for r, c, v in markers)
    kr1 = max(r for r, c, v in markers)
    kc0 = min(c for r, c, v in markers)
    kc1 = max(c for r, c, v in markers)
    scale = (r1 - r0 + 1) // (kr1 - kr0 + 1)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, c, color in coords8:
        out[r][c] = 0
    for r, c, color in markers:
        rr, cc = c - kc0, (kr1 - kr0) - (r - kr0)
        for dr in range(scale):
            for dc in range(scale):
                y, x = r0 + rr * scale + dr, c0 + cc * scale + dc
                if 0 <= y < h and 0 <= x < w and grid[y][x] == 8:
                    out[y][x] = color
    return out
'''
progdir=base/'programs'; progdir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
path=progdir/'task-3a364b38.py'; path.write_text(program)
print(path, path.read_text())
